name: Al Taschith
overview: The term 'Al Taschith,' found in the titles of Psalms 57-59 and Psalm 75, introduces a theme of God's sovereign judgment and protection. Psalm 75 emphasizes giving thanks to God, who upholds the earth and judges with righteousness, warning the wicked not to exalt themselves arrogantly. This teaching underscores that true promotion and authority come solely from God, not from human power or position, encouraging believers to trust in His just and gracious rule.
